gate: Both independent route training runs must pass paired task gains and flat retention; aggregate>=9/10 on101/107, eachrun>=4/5. No new-terrain physics before gate and final executable protocol are locked.
proposed_scope: All4 terrains, both final learned policies, each with its own same-start original-base control;5x2000 task plus2x1000flat per arm/terrain/run;max192000 controls. No terrain selection, replacement starts, gradients or feedback-driven checkpoint choice.
acceptance: For every new terrain candidate aggregate>=9/10 and each learned run>=4/5, no safety violations, all eligible paired retention tests pass; candidate total no more than1/10 below matched base. This is a bounded simulation claim, not universal terrain or hardware qualification.
runtime_requirement: Current legacy development allow-list needs an explicit registered extension after active source-bound training/evaluation finishes. Sealed membership must remain disjoint.
